झङ्कार: झंकार झंकार, i. e. झम्, an imi-tative sound, -कार, m. Humming, Bhāg. P. 8, 8, 43.
झंकार: झंकार झंकार, i. e. झम्, an imi-tative sound, -कार, m. Humming, Bhāg. P. 8, 8, 43.
झंकारित: झंकारित झंकारित, i. e. झम्-का-रित (ptcple. pf. pass. of the Caus. of कृ; cf. the last), n. Humming, Bhartṛ. 1, 97.
झञ्झा: झञ्झा झञ्झा, i. e. probably a re-duplicated form of झम् (cf. झंकार), f. A sharp clanging sound, Amar, 48.
झट्: झट् झट्, i. 1, Par. To be en-tangled; cf. जट्। -- With the prep. उद् उद्, उज्झटित, Confused, Rājat. 1, 116.
झटिति: झटिति झटिति, i. e. झटत् (?), pro-bably based on an imitative sound, -इति, adv. Instantly, in a moment, Bhartṛ. i. 69; on a sudden, Daśak. in Chr. 186, 15.
झणझण: झणझण झणझण, a reduplicated form of the imitative sound झणत् (cf. इहणत्कार), Tinkling, Kathās. 25, 222.
झणत्कार: झणत्कार झणत्-कार (see the last), m. Tinkling, Prab, 40, 6, v. r.
झनज्झना: झनज्झना झनज्झना, a redupli-cated form of an imitative sound झनत् (cf. झणत्कार ?). The sound caused by the flapping of an elephant's ear, Kām. Nītis. 1, 45.
झम्: † झम् झम्, i. 1, Par. To eat.  -- Cf. जम्।
झरी: झरी झरी (probably a form of a derivative from क्षर्), f. A water-fall, Prab. 73, 1.
झर्च्: † झर्च् झर्च्, झर्छ् झर्छ्, झर्झ् झर्झ्, i. 1, and 6, Par.  1. To explain.  2. To menace.  3. To hurt.
झर्झर: झर्झर झर्झर, i. e. झर्झर्, a re-duplicated form of an imitative sound, + अ, m. and f. री, A kind of drum, MBh. 6, 4463; Rām. 6, 99, 23 (but Sch., A flute); Hariv. 13212.
झर्झरिन्: झर्झरिन् झर्झरिन्, i. e. झर्झर + इन्, adj. Provided with a drum, MBh. 12, 10406.
झलज्झला: झलज्झला झलज्झला, i. e. a redu-plicated form of झलत्, an imitative sound, and aff. अ, f. The sounding of falling drops, Amar. 9, v. r.
झल्ल: झल्ल झल्ल, m. A prize-fighter, considered as the son of an outcaste Kṣatriya, MBh. 2, 102; Man. 10, 22.
झष्: † झष् झष्, i. 1, Par., Ātm.  1. To take.  2. To cover. i. 1, Par. To hurt.
झष: झष झष, m.  1. A fish, MBh. 1, 8316.  2. The sign Pisces.
झिल्लि: झिल्लि झिल्लि, झिल्लिका झिल्लि + का, and झिल्ली झिल्ली, f. A cricket, Hariv. 3497; Rām. 1, 26, 13; Bhāg. P. 5, 13, 5.
झिल्लीक: झिल्लीक झिल्ली + क, m. A cricket, MBh. 1, 2849.
झूष्: † झूष् झूष्, v. r. for जूष्।
झॄ: † झॄ झॄ, i. 4, झीर्य; ii. 9, झृणा, णी, m. To grow old, v. r. -- Cf. जॄ।
झोड: झोड झोड, m. The betel-nut tree.
झौलिक: झौलिक झौलिक, i. e. झोड + इक, A little pouch containing betel, Dhūrtas. 95, 8.
झ्यु: † झ्यु झ्यु, i. 1, Par. To go, v. r.
